reason: The existing mapping to Article 5(1)(b) of the Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301 provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. The provision explicitly requires the submission of an intermediate report 'at the latest within 72 hours from the submission of the initial notification, even where the status or the handling of the incident have not changed', which directly corresponds to the control statement.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to financial entities as defined in Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, which is the parent regulation for the reporting requirements detailed in the Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301.
challenge_comment: The control statement specifies a 72-hour deadline for the intermediate report, which is a critical aspect of incident reporting. The cited provision in Article 5(1)(b) clearly establishes this mandatory timeline, ensuring the control is adequately covered.
